blocks.text: Set it from the top-right of the screen in Video or SuperNight mode.

items: Colour: Normal 8-bit, Normal 10-bit, HLG 10-bit, D-Log M 10-bit.
**D-Log M** keeps the most dynamic range for grading. Turn on Color Recovery to preview normal colours.
Lock exposure and white balance for video, same as on any camera.
**Pre-Rec:** keeps the seconds before you press record.
**Loop recording:** overwrites old footage, like a dashcam.
**Voice control:** Start Recording, Stop Recording, Take Photo, Shut Down.
Record 4K, 2.7K or 1080p 16:9 at 100 fps or more.
In playback, stop at the moment and tap the slow-motion icon.
Creates a 1080p clip up to 960 fps with 4× frame interpolation.
Up to 6 per video; not in the first 1.5 s or last 2 s.
Battery door closed with **no red marks showing**. USB-C cover and lens cover on tight; seals clean.
Not waterproof with the lens hood fitted.
Don't jump into water at speed with it; the impact can force water in.
Afterwards rinse in tap water and let it air-dry. No hair dryer.
Pairs with up to two DJI wireless mics over Bluetooth.
**Built-in Mic Audio Backup** saves a separate .wav as a safety copy.
Wind noise reduction only works on the built-in mic.
